note: KEEPITIL Apps catalog. Only real KEEPITIL apps and games that already have a page on keepitil.com. Every href, icon and image is a root-relative path to a file in this repo (the /app/ test in assets/js checks it). No prices, ratings or reviews. Kids items link only to their own page. hidden: true keeps an entry out of the rendered store (pre-launch). adults: true items (age-restricted; age rules vary by state) render only in a shelf marked adults: true, never on Today, in a feature or next to a kids shelf.
